scenarios.title: Two-person forced stockroom window entry and van getaway
scenarios.hypothesis_summary: Two intruders arrived by panel van at the south end of the service lane, walked north, forced the stockroom west window person with the tool a pry bar, and one climbed in feet-first while the other stayed at the sill. The inside intruder took drills from the racking, person with the tool to the office, opened the safe and took the cash, then passed boxes out through the window to be carried and loaded into the van before both left southwards. The cleaner heard arrival sounds earlier from Unit 5 and the keyholder later entered through the customer door and disarmed the alarm.

supporting_facts.text: A light-coloured van stopped at the south end of the lane and two people in dark clothing got out and walked north to the stockroom window.
The stockroom window was prised open, a pry bar was left under it, and person with the tool climbed in feet-first while the other stayed at the sill.
Alarm sensors recorded window shock, stockroom and office motion, and the safe door opening in sequence.
Boxes were handed through the window, carried to the van, loaded, and the van left southwards.
About 20 boxed drills and the cash float were reported taken, the safe was open and empty, and footwear marks led from the window toward the office door.

contradicted_points.text: The identities of the two intruders are not established; faces and the van plate were not recorded.
The cleaner reported hearing a van and two doors at about 01:10, whereas the CCTV log places the van arrival at 01:39, and no camera clock offset was recorded.
How the safe was opened is not established; its keypad showed no damage.

scenarios.hypothesis_summary: Two intruders first entered through the customer door after it was recorded unlocked with card K02 late in the evening, hid inside, and later moved stock and cash before going out to the lane and van. The later forcing and climbing in at the stockroom window was a re-entry after fetching or positioning the van, after which boxes were passed out and loaded as in the CCTV log. This takes the customer door as the original entry despite strong contrary indications from the undisturbed front door and the CCTV window entry.

Who used card K02 at 23:48 is not established, and the evidence does not identify Tobias as an intruder.

findings.text: Step 9 has no cited evidence for an earlier window exit before the van phase, and steps 10-12 reinterpret CCTV that two people get out of the van at 01:40, one works at the frame at 01:41 and one climbs in feet-first at 01:42 as a re-entry rather than the arrival it directly shows.
